model.title: Foreign Service Modernization Act
model.meta: Ways and Means Committee, Foreign Affairs Committee · Rep. Michael Lawler (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would modernize the Foreign Service by requiring the State Department to develop plans for diplomats to work in high-risk environments, establish programs to recruit military veterans, and create a reserve corps for emergency staffing needs. It would also mandate leadership training for officers before promotions, protect the careers of those pursuing external education, and require foreign language-trained diplomats to serve in positions using those languages.
